item.title: What Should I Do With the Life I Have Left?
item.description: 30-second summary: I built a tiny life-countdown website that turns the abstract idea of “the future is long” into a timeline you can actually see. That made me revisit a question that the past few years of pessimism and FIRE-number-crunching had quietly replaced — not “how do I retire as soon as possible / avoid getting hurt by this era,” but “what do I actually want to trade the next several decades for.” This post doesn’t have an answer; it’s just a record of starting to ask that question again.
